body: The courier’s torn tabard bears Briarhaven’s crest. His stiff hand holds a duty slip: northern patrols were withdrawn before he reached the bend. Tovin’s account and the wounds agree.
boots: Heavy boots lead east through red clay, away from the courier’s riding-shoe prints. Beyond them, narrow crate-wheel ruts continue toward Ironhollow.
cart: A broken wheel and two embedded arrows mark a prepared ambush. The strongbox is untouched; the dispatch sleeve was cut away. Whoever hired the attackers wanted orders, not money.
harness: Cut harness and discarded raider knife
The leather was sliced while the wagon stood still. The discarded knife matches raider equipment. Someone planned to stop the courier here.
